mainEntity.name: What SAP systems does Praman support?

acceptedAnswer.text: Praman supports SAP S/4HANA (on-premise and cloud), SAP BTP applications, SAP Fiori Launchpad, and any web application built with SAPUI5 or OpenUI5. It works with both SAP Fiori Elements and custom UI5 freestyle apps.

mainEntity.name: Do I need access to SAP source code to use Praman?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Praman interacts with UI5 controls through the public runtime API (sap.ui.getCore()). It queries the control registry at runtime, so you only need browser access to the application.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Praman with existing Playwright tests?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Praman extends Playwright — it does not replace it. You can mix Praman fixtures (ui5, ui5Navigation, ui5Table) with native Playwright APIs (page.click(), page.locator()) in the same test file.

mainEntity.name: How does Praman compare to wdi5?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both access the UI5 control registry. Praman is built on Playwright (faster, modern), while wdi5 uses WebdriverIO. Praman adds typed control proxies with full IntelliSense, AI-powered test generation, Fiori Elements page-object helpers, OData V2/V4 mock/intercept utilities, and 10 UI5-specific Playwright matchers.

mainEntity.name: How does AI test generation work in Praman?

acceptedAnswer.text: Praman integrates with AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Jules). You describe what to test in business language, and the agent generates production-ready Playwright tests using Praman fixtures with typed control proxies — not brittle selectors.

mainEntity.name: What authentication methods does Praman support for SAP?

acceptedAnswer.text: Praman supports 6 authentication strategies: BTP SAML, Basic Auth, Office 365, Client Certificate, Custom IDP, and Manual login. Authentication is handled in seed tests and sessions are reused across test runs.

mainEntity.name: How many SAP UI5 controls does Praman support?

acceptedAnswer.text: Praman supports 61 UI5 control types across 8 SAP libraries: sap.m, sap.ui.table, sap.ui.comp, sap.uxap, sap.f, sap.ui.mdc, sap.ui.unified, and sap.ui.core. Each control type has a fully typed proxy with IntelliSense.

mainEntity.name: Is Praman free and open source?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Praman is licensed under Apache-2.0 and is completely free. It has only 3 production dependencies (commander, pino, zod), all MIT-licensed. The source code is available on GitHub.

HowTo_GettingStarted.name: How to Set Up SAP UI5 Test Automation with Praman and Playwright
HowTo_GettingStarted.description: Get up and running with Praman in 5 steps: install, initialize, configure credentials, verify, and generate tests.

step.name: Initialize project
step.text: Run: npx playwright-praman init — scaffolds config files, auth setup, and verification test.

step.name: Configure SAP credentials
step.text: Copy .env.example to .env and set SAP_CLOUD_BASE_URL, SAP_CLOUD_USERNAME, SAP_CLOUD_PASSWORD, and SAP_AUTH_STRATEGY.

step.name: Verify setup
step.text: Run: npx playwright test tests/bom-e2e-praman-gold-standard.spec.ts --headed — a passing test confirms full setup.

step.name: Generate tests with AI
step.text: Use /praman-sap-coverage in Claude Code or describe your business process — AI agents generate production-ready test scripts.
